body_html:
Meet the maestro of melodies, DJ Casen, hailing from the picturesque Blue Ridge, GA. Music is in his DNA, as he follows in the footsteps of a family of DJs. In fact, his Dad still spins the tunes, passing the rhythm torch to the next generation.

But DJ Casen is no ordinary music enthusiast. He’s a student at KSU, Georgia, juggling academics and a passion for hosting diverse events. From electrifying trivia nights to soulful jam sessions, Casen knows how to keep the groove going.

At KSU, he’s not just a student; he’s a Jazz performance prodigy. As a freelance musician, percussionist, composer, and pianist, he crafts symphonies that touch the soul. His musical tastes are as eclectic as his talents – from the hard-hitting metal to the soothing rhythms of lo-fi hip hop, you’ll find it all in Casen’s headphones.

Casen lives by the wise words of Louis Armstrong: “When music is good, it’s good.” Genre boundaries can’t contain his love for great music.

What sets Casen apart is his youthful exuberance and raw energy. He’s a musical chameleon who can adapt to any audience, reading the room’s vibes and choosing the perfect tracks to keep the flow going. His ability to connect with the crowd is nothing short of magical.

So, whether you’re craving a jazz symphony, a jamming trivia night, or a night of heart-pounding beats, DJ Casen is your go-to maestro. He’s here to make your event unforgettable, one note at a time!
